title: colourscroller
description: This mod allows you to have one item in one hotbar slot and scroll it to other items of the same type.
body:
This mod allows you to scroll in hotbar for variants of items, so you only need to have one item of each type in your hotbar. You can customize the lists of items, by default there will be lists of coloured blocks (wool, concrete, terracotta, glass), you can add lists like log variants and so on.
